worldcup.title: Dynamic pricing to be used for games in US during 2031 Women’s World Cup
worldcup.summary: Ticketing model was in place for 2026 men’s World Cup Fans criticized system but Fifa saw record revenues A dynamic pricing model is set to be used in ticket sales for games held in the United States at the 2031 Women’s World Cup, which will be co-hosted with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica. Sources involved with the bid, which was formally ratified by Fifa on Monday, have told the Guardian it is inevitable that variable pricing will be used in the US after its successful application at last summer’s men’s World Cup, which generated about $5bn in ticket sales and hospitality, a significant increase on Fifa’s projection of $3.3bn.
